start.title: [TODO:es] A Life in Ur
start.text:
[TODO:es] Seventy-five years behind you.
The city hums. Your heart is restless.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Step to the rooftop and listen

the_call.title: [TODO:es] The Voice
the_call.text:
[TODO:es] A voice — clear, unmistakable.
"Leave your land. Go where I will show you."

the_promise.title: [TODO:es] The Promise
the_promise.text:
[TODO:es] "I will make of you a great nation.
All peoples will be blessed through you."

telling_sarah.title: [TODO:es] Telling Sarah
telling_sarah.text:
[TODO:es] Sarah's eyes search yours.
"What did the voice ask of us?"

choices.text: [TODO:es] Hide the truth to spare her
[TODO:es] Ask her to decide for you

preparing.title: [TODO:es] Gathering What Matters
preparing.text:
[TODO:es] Tents. Flocks. A few bundles.
A whole life cannot fit on a camel.

departure.title: [TODO:es] The Gate at Dawn
departure.text:
[TODO:es] Ur watches you leave.
Some weep. Some shake their heads.

the_road.title: [TODO:es] The Long Road
the_road.text:
[TODO:es] Sun. Sand. Endless horizon.
Sarah walks beside you in silence.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Turn back — this is too much

doubt_night.title: [TODO:es] The Long Night
doubt_night.text:
[TODO:es] Inside the tent, the silence is heavy.
"What if I have misheard?"

stargazing.title: [TODO:es] Under the Stars
stargazing.text:
[TODO:es] The sky is wide. Countless lights.
"So shall your offspring be."

canaan_arrival.title: [TODO:es] The Land of Canaan
canaan_arrival.text:
[TODO:es] Green hills. Running water. A land that breathes.
"This land I give to your offspring."

choices.text: [TODO:es] Claim it loudly as your own

altar.title: [TODO:es] The Altar
altar.text:
[TODO:es] You gather stones and kneel.
Faith has carried you here. It will carry you on.
